Step-by-Step Guide

Tap any step timer to launch Cook Mode right there

restaurant_menu
1

Prepare Dough & Shape Uniformly

Combine 2 cups all-purpose or bread flour, 3/4 cup warm milk + yeast (or baking powder), and 4 tbsp melted butter + 1 egg into a smooth elastic dough or batter. Shape evenly and rest 15 mins. Keep 2 cups all-purpose or bread flour, 3/4 cup warm milk + yeast (or baking powder), and 4 tbsp melted butter + 1 egg prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.

2

Cook Golden & Finish with Glaze

Bake at 375°F (190°C) or air-fry 14–16 mins (or fry 3 mins) until golden puffed, then fill or drizzle with 3/4 cup pure madagascar vanilla bean paste and 1/2 cup powdered sugar or cinnamon sugar dust.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Glaze or dust with sugar while still warm so the coating clings cleanly.

3

Bake Pączki & Check Doneness

Bake for 16 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

4

Rest 5 Minutes & Serve Warm

Carefully lift Pączki out of the air-fryer basket and rest 5 minutes on a cooling rack so the crust crisps up. Plate into 6 servings and enjoy warm.

Nutrition, Storage & Healthy Prep Notes

CALORIES315 kcal
SERVINGS6
SUGAR MODEClassic

Make-Ahead & Storage: Keep pączki in an airtight glass container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days (or freeze individual portions up to 1 month). Pair with unsweetened Greek yogurt, fresh berries, or espresso for a balanced treat.

Keto & Low-Sugar Tip: Toggle Healthy Swap above to substitute refined sugar with monk fruit or coconut sugar and white flour with oat or almond flour.
